text:
Emmalee: Quick sync — AcmeHealth POC is greenlit, they want to sign this week. Need: final signer mapping, PO placement guidance, and confirmation on two SLA redline asks from their security team. Can legal+finance advise?
chris_legal: I got the redlines. Main ask is tightening uptime SLA to 99.9% and adding a data-transfer audit right. Are these deal-breakers?
maria_ps: 99.9% is higher than our standard for POC reserved capacity, we can offer a POC SLA exception for a limited pilot but need limits in the order form and timebox it.
devon_finance: PO needs to reference the order form + MSA. Do we require PO number before countersign? Standard is PO before activation for enterprise. Net45 okay?
Emmalee: Customer asked for Net30. They mentioned finance dept needs invoice tied to PO and vendor W9.
maria_ps: For the SLA change we can propose this language to limit exposure: "Elevated SLA applies only to POC period (30 days) and caps service credits at monthly invoice amount." Want me to draft?
chris_legal: Yes please draft. Also they redlined section 7.2 (data access) to add quarterly audit rights and subprocessor list obligations. We should push back on standing audit unless scoped. Ask for "audit upon reasonable notice and scope limited to customer data and controls."
sam_solutions: FYI: technical delivery: we need the signer mapping so our onboarding team can enable the right routes in Console. Prefer one primary and one backup signer with emails.
Emmalee: Primary: j.park@acmehealth.com (VP Ops). Backup: m.lopez@acmehealth.com (Procurement). They prefer DocuSign.
devon_finance: Net30 vs Net45 — we can accept Net30 for this customer if they put PO for full pilot amount. What's the PO amount?
Emmalee: PO will be for $45,000 — covers Dedicated pilot for 30 days + support line.
chris_legal: Draft snippet for the limited SLA addendum: ```The Parties agree that for the Pilot Term only, Provider will use commercially reasonable efforts to meet a 99.9% monthly uptime. In no event will Provider's aggregate liability for service credits under this Pilot exceed the total fees paid for the Pilot Term.```
maria_ps: That looks good. Add a clause that elevated SLA auto-reverts to standard terms after pilot unless both parties agree.
chris_legal: Will add. On DPA audit request propose: "Customer may request an on-site or remote audit once during the Pilot Term with 30 days' notice and at Customer's expense; scope limited to systems and processes that process Customer Data."
devon_finance: Sounds fair. For invoicing we need PO number, billing contact, and W9. Can Sales confirm billing contact?
Emmalee: Billing contact is m.lopez@acmehealth.com. I'll ask them to send PO and W9 now.
signbot: deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x7f9a sent to j.park@acmehealth.com and m.lopez@acmehealth.com — 2 signers.
sam_solutions: Once signed, onboarding needs the signer mapping in this format: `{"primary":"j.park@acmehealth.com","backup":"m.lopez@acmehealth.com"}` so we can auto-config routes.
chris_legal: Emmalee — I'll attach redline PDF and the SLA addendum in the thread. Please confirm acceptance lines for PO/net terms and I will finalize.
Emmalee: Thanks — confirm PO amount $45k, Net30, DocuSign signers above. Customer ok with 30-day pilot SLA cap and single audit with 30 days notice. I'll ping when PO/W9 arrive. :thumbsup:
devon_finance: Great. Once we have PO + W9 we can issue invoice and enable account.
Emmalee: PO and W9 inbound from m.lopez@acmehealth.com. Sending now.
signbot: deploy-bot: DocuSign envelope 0x7f9a completed by j.park@acmehealth.com at 2024-08-31T15:02:40Z
sam_solutions: Received signed envelope, starting onboarding checklist. Emmalee — can you confirm orderform ID to attach to PO?
Emmalee: Orderform ID: RF-2024-ACME-001. Attach to PO and invoice.
chris_legal: Final step — I'll generate countersigned MSA + Addendum and route back to Emmalee for delivery. Good to close this thread once done.
Emmalee: Thanks everyone — closing after countersign. :party_parrot:
